topic: flpianoroll per-note velocity (0..1) is documented but silently lands as FL's default 120 on FL 21.2.2

evidence.machine: Windows 11, FL Studio Producer Edition v21.2.2 build 3914
evidence.symptom: apply_notes wrote 32 notes with velocity floats 0.818-0.850; the owner-saved .flp dumped byte-exact (flp_notes.py) showed EVERY note velocity = 120 (FL default). The manual (pianoroll_scripting_api.htm) documents velocity 0.0..1.0 with 'MIDI velocity of 127 corresponds to FL velocity of 1.0', so the API CLAIMS support; this build drops it.
evidence.cure: treat per-note dynamics as advisory through this path: shape velocity in the Piano roll velocity lane, or byte-patch the SAVED .flp note-event velocity field after the owner saves (flp_notes.py patch), or await a re-probe on a newer FL build
evidence.cross_reference: vault lane log entry 2026-09-21 01:58 (field incident); docs/API_CAPABILITY_AUDIT.md evidence grading

laws: manual-documented != measured-working on the target build: grade features as DOCUMENTED+MEASURED vs DOCUMENTED-ONLY
readback of note velocity through the controller is api-limited -- 'ok:true count:N' proves serialization, NOT musical result
when the user asks for dynamics via agent writes, say which layer will actually carry them
reproduction: fl_write_piano_roll_notes 8 notes with velocity 0.5 and 0.9 alternating; Ctrl+S in FL; dump the .flp note records: all velocities read 120
open_questions: does a newer FL scripting API version persist 0..1 velocity (needs live 25.x/26.x rig)
is the drop in flp.Note assignment or in score serialization (undetectable from inside the script sandbox)
next_recommended_action: Treat the documented behaviour as build-specific; re-probe on your FL build and report the result.
